cli.output_directory: absolute, non-root path; mkdir(0700) must succeed exclusively; existing paths rejected
cli.compile_only: Two separate real Convolution1D create_pipeline calls, full scalar host weight/bias layout checks and payload clones; returns before acquiring Vulkan allocators, uploading tensors, constructing VkTransfer/VkCompute or CPU output oracle. Host model and snapshot arrays are allocated; device initialization may submit dummy work. No output directory/files.

exit_codes.0: compile-only checks passed, or full paired numerical/readback checks passed and completion manifest published
exit_codes.1: CHECK failure; no completion manifest published before validation; already captured raw evidence retained

selector.name: RADISH_NCNN_PLANAR_PACKED_A
selector.sampling: Production create_pipeline only; helper never manually packs GPU weights.

layer.create_pipeline_wall_scope: Includes packing plus shader/pipeline creation, not isolated packing time.

math_contract.actual_chunks_submits_native_timer: Separate independent root qualification; helper does not infer them from group count. No assumed candidate native length.

upload_and_lifetimes.weights: Actual layer.upload_model through VkTransfer, followed by wait; candidate payload never manually copied/repacked to GPU. Clone actual weight_data_packed before upload releases it.
upload_and_lifetimes.bias: Clone actual bias_data before upload releases it. Read back actual uploaded layer bias_data_gpu.
upload_and_lifetimes.allocations: All 17 ranges resident, valid and pairwise non-overlapping throughout twelve calls. Layer owners/model/snapshots/GPU wrappers outlive downloads; allocator pool reclaimed after layer owners.

fixture.packed_weight: packed[k*128+co] bit-identical to original[co*1408+k] for every k/co; owned flat scalar FP32 Mat
fixture.input: B[ci*268+xpad]=B_integer(ci,xpad)/64; outside active interval positive zero
fixture.oracle: numerator=q(co)+sum(ci=0..127,tap=0..10) a(co,ci*11+tap)*B_integer(ci,x+tap); expected=numerator/4096; check each partial abs<=295807<2^24
fixture.validation: Exact float bits for every scalar per run and byte-identical all twelve output payloads, including OFF/ON; source model unchanged; actual GPU weights/biases/input unchanged.

poison_and_guards.uint32_bits: Native uint32 word bits; exact comparisons by memcpy
poison_and_guards.uploads: All twelve changing-NaN payloads and unique four-word tail guards uploaded before sequence

schedule.elapsed: Set RADISH_GPU_ELAPSED=1 for every call; baseline CALIBRATION unset; candidate RADISH_GPU_ELAPSED_CALIBRATION=packed-a; set elapsed=0 after each wait.
schedule.timing: record_pipeline plus submit_and_wait only. Every output/model/input GPU readback follows all twelve waits. CPU oracle and all writes outside intervals.

raw_capture.encoding: Native IEEE-754 binary32 byte layout; intended little-endian aarch64 target, no conversion
raw_capture.before: Expected actual upload payload snapshots; includes transposed candidate weights, not original-only comparison.
raw_capture.after: Actual GPU VkMat readback by record_clone with allocation-appropriate shape checks; scalar model and guarded vec4 input/output helpers differ.

metadata.pending: pending.json created exclusively with format and status=pending; contains no success claim
metadata.completion: result.json.tmp created exclusively after all validation. Pending marker removed before atomic exclusive link to result.json. result.json publication is final fallible completion step; temporary-link cleanup is best effort. result.json status=passed means helper numerical/layout/readback validation only. If publication fails, no result.json exists; pending may already be removed.
metadata.result: result.json includes all run wall times and two create_pipeline wall intervals, raw counts, guard counts and independent admission pending statement.
metadata.file_policy: openat O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC mode0600 for all artifacts; failures preserve prior raw files.

markers.failure: FAIL line <line>: <expression> to stderr; CLI/required env diagnostics to stderr

independent_runner: Owns execution/service/adb decisions; helper never invokes adb/systemd, alters driver settings, or assumes native resource admission.
host_check: host_source_check.py and host-source-check.json provide only source/index/fixture checks, not C++ compilation or GPU evidence.
